author: KEXP
description:
Ahead of their live performance at the KEXP BBQ, pioneering Peruvian cumbia outfit Los Mirlos take to the stage for a special Live on KEXP session from Hidden Hall. With their latest release 'The World Meets Los Mirlos' in tow, the group share a layered and lively performance of "La Fuga Del Jaguar" and more. 

This session was made as part of our VIP Club Donor series. To learn more about how to take part in special performances like this one, head to kexp.org/donate.
title: Los Mirlos performs "La Fuga Del Jaguar" & more Live on KEXP
